name: Crow
description_en: A Fast and Easy to use microframework for the web.
readme_excerpt: A Fast and Easy to use microframework for the web. Description Crow is a C++ framework for creating HTTP or Websocket web services. It uses routing similar to Python's Flask which makes it easy to use. It is also extremely fast, beating multiple existing C++ frameworks as well as non-C++ frameworks.
